summary: AMTD Digital filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit containing the interim results of its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group, for the six months ended June 30, 2026. TGE reported revenue from customer contracts up 35.8% to $30.8 million, net profit of $22.8 million, EPS of $0.56, total assets of $1.8 billion, and net asset value of $932.5 million. The announcement recaps completed hospitality acquisitions and coffee-bar openings. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer results filing, warranting no special-situations classification.
